name: cem-revit-ai
description: Cemengal Revit MCP server — 54 generic Revit tools (core, MEP, architecture, family) driven by Claude over a socket to the Revit plugin.
long_description: Connects Claude to Autodesk Revit through the CEM_RevitAI plugin (socket on localhost:8080). Provides generic, AI-friendly tools across core (parameters, views, sheets, tagging, transforms, warnings), MEP (ducts/pipes/conduit/cable tray/equipment/spaces/systems), architecture (walls/floors/ceilings/rooms/openings) and families (load/place/types/editor parameters). Start the server from the CEM_RevitAI ribbon button in Revit before use.
